channel.title: The Moonlit Majlis: History for Sleep
channel.description: Calm, slow history to fall asleep to. Each episode is a gentle, well-researched journey through Arabia, the Silk Road and the Islamic Golden Age: caravans and pearl divers, astronomers and libraries, travellers and traders. Best with the volume low. Narration uses an AI voice (Kokoro); the research and writing are made for this show. New episodes every week.
